01 · Who we are

Who we are

Barro Industries OPC, well known as Barro Kitchens, designs, fabricates, delivers and installs premium stainless-steel kitchens from its base in Quezon City, Metro Manila.

The company began as a family business in Baguio City and La Union and has been in business for 23 years. Our kitchens have long been known as Barro Kitchens.

Barro Industries OPC is an SEC-registered manufacturing company built on precision, quality and a commitment to long-term growth.

We work end to end. We visit your site, plan the layout, build every piece to order, deliver and install it, and commission it for use. Service and support continue after handover.

03 · What we do

What we do

The same high-quality build runs through every service: seams welded and ground smooth, surfaces polished to a professional finish, and every piece built to order.

Commercial & commissary kitchen fit-outs

Design-build from concept to completion: cooking lines, preparation and washing stations, baking equipment, exhaust hoods and ducting, fresh-air systems, gas lines and fire suppression. One contractor, from drawings to commissioning.

Custom stainless & metal fabrication

Work tables, sinks, cabinets, shelving and racks in stainless steel, plus railings, gates, structural and sheet-metal work fabricated to your drawing, in stainless or mild steel, for commercial and residential sites.

Institutional & government supply

Stainless-steel equipment, work tables and sinks supplied and installed for schools, LGUs and government agencies through public bidding.

Exhaust & fresh-air systems

Hoods, ducting and fresh-air supply that remove heat, smoke and grease and keep the air in your kitchen moving.

LPG gas line installation

A centralised gas supply from an external tank farm to your cooking equipment, with safety controls built in.

Kitchen fire suppression

Wet chemical fire suppression integrated with your range hood, protecting the cooking surface and the exhaust path.

Hoods, exhaust, fresh air, gas line and fire suppression are planned together with your cooking line, as part of one kitchen layout.

05 · Materials and finishes

Two grades, three finishes

We work in two grades, food-grade SS304 as standard and laboratory-grade SS316 on request, in a brushed, mirror or satin finish.

Standard

SS304 food grade

Food-grade SS304 stainless steel is our standard for kitchens: preparation tables, sinks, cabinets, shelving and racks.

On request

SS316 laboratory grade

Laboratory-grade SS316 stainless steel is available on request and suits laboratories and school science rooms.

Finishes

Brushed

A visible straight grain. The usual choice for work surfaces, because it hides everyday scratches.

Mirror

Polished to a high gloss. It suits decorative parts and low-contact areas.

Satin

A soft, low-sheen finish between brushed and mirror, with a smoother, more even look.

The swatches are illustrations. Ask to see a sample before you decide.

Made-to-order tables, sinks and stoves have a 1.5 mm (16 gauge) top plate; bodies and shelving are 1.2 mm; floor-standing pieces stand on square-tube posts with adjustable bullet feet.
Need SS316? Say so when you send a project brief or message us, and we will confirm it for your project.

06 · Built to order

Built to order

Every piece is made to your exact dimensions. Seams are welded and ground smooth, and surfaces are polished to a professional finish.

From drawing to finished piece

Drawings

We prepare precise drawings from your kitchen’s layout.

Cutting, punching and bending

Industrial machines cut, punch and bend the metal into shape.

Welding and grinding

Skilled technicians weld the components together and grind down any rough seams, so every surface is smooth and easy to clean.

Polishing

Surfaces are polished to a professional finish.

What made to order means

Your sizes

Set your own length, width and height. Nothing is cut to a catalogue size you did not choose.

Your layout

The equipment is planned around your space and the way your team works.

Your options

Layers, sinks, burners, tiers, doors and shelves are chosen one by one.
